description: US Treasury auction results, or the auctions announced next, from the Treasury itself: bills, notes, bonds, TIPS and FRNs by term ("10-year", "13-week bill"), with the rate each cleared at, coupon, bid-to-cover, size and the shares taken by indirect bidders (foreign and other), direct bidders and primary dealers, plus averages to compare the latest auction with recent ones.

security.description: Which securities: "10-year", "2-year note", "30-year bond", "13-week bill", "5-year TIPS", "2-year FRN", or a kind ("bills", "notes", "bonds", "tips"). Default: all.

since.description: Results from this auction date; default 180 days ago.

until.description: Results up to this auction date; default today.

upcoming.description: Announced auctions not yet held, soonest first, instead of results.

name: treasury_auctions

outputSchema.description: rows are auctions in the order of columns, newest first (soonest first when upcoming); shares are fractions of the competitive amount accepted.

title: Treasury auctions
